causal_distinctions: requests are accepted only by taken valid/ready or source-defined accept
reply observation is not successful response retirement without native validation and identity proof
WINDOW staged/row publication differs from source/descriptor completion
CKV local fetch/three remote/own row all retained as parallel collector sources
rows_ready/fetch_done differs from selection lifetime quiescence
QK/PV replay share selection epoch but have distinct acceptance IDs/generations
frozen queues/PC/busy/state changes cannot reset or supply operation deadlines

event_envelope.association_proven: strict bool model input only; actual source/epoch/fence binding certificate is currently unavailable
event_envelope.beat: u4, must0 for pinned one-sector reply
event_envelope.cycle: u64 ordered source rising-edge observation (equal for concurrent lanes)
event_envelope.link_queue: operation/request must absent; does not create outstanding DUT operation
event_envelope.qualified: strict bool native validation/fault predicate; false cannot retire work
event_envelope.retire_label: exact source-owned completion per family; no selection lifetime-retire hook available

name: opentallas.operation-deadline-provider-observation.v1

operation_identity.accept_serial: u64 monotonic host observation of actual named accept
operation_identity.die_rank: u2 physical rank, distinct from selection_rank
operation_identity.native_generation: optional u16 descriptor generation; missing remains DESCRIPTOR_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE
operation_identity.reset_epoch: u64 host observation, requires reset/transport fence provenance
operation_identity.selection_epoch: optional full accepted ckV_selection OperationID; same physical rank/reset epoch; missing for fetch/replay remains SELECTION_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE

provider_outputs.ages: now-actual acceptance, fixed accepted-request timestamps; no heartbeat slides origin
provider_outputs.deadline: None with missing bounds; optional numbers labeled SYNTHETIC only
provider_outputs.status: BOUND_MISSING plus missing context/association/native-qualification statuses; synthetic violations remain visible after late completion

registered_stage_identity.reply: wb_rsp_v (no rsp_ready), same user/first/mask, lane-valid mask covering request and no source fault

request_identity.client_tag: u14, before two owner transport bits
request_identity.mode: read/write; WINDOW write_done distinct; selected CKV writes rejected by pinned mux
request_identity.ordinal: u64 unique for operation even if wire metadata changes

scope: model only; no provider callback/getter selected
